title: Holmes 2020 · Supplementary Experiment 5, discrimination feasibility
citation: Holmes, N. P., Martin, D. J., Mitchell, W., Noorani, Z., & Thorne, A. (2020). Do sounds near the hand facilitate tactile reaction times? Four experiments and a meta-analysis provide mixed support and suggest a small effect size. Experimental Brain Research, 238, 995–1009.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

reference_parameters.planner_scope: The source settings describe this companion procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for it.

published_method.scope: Three observers tested on replacement Nottingham hardware in 2019, within two approximately one-hour sessions per observer. The stimulator type was similar to the earlier setup.
published_method.order: Reach 90% detection without hitting the QUEST ceiling, then perform detection under each interval/mask combination before the four discrimination blocks.

discrimination.response_1IFC: Classify the single presented vibration as weak or strong.
discrimination.response_2IFC: Choose which interval contained the stronger vibration.

published_method.scoring: The supplement labels 27/44 as above chance. Exact binomial p under chance 0.5 is approximately 0.087 one-sided or 0.174 two-sided. The original calculation and threshold rule are unresolved.

stimulus_type.value: Continuous white noise or discrete noise pulses.

source_provenance.value: White noise timing and stimuli related to the main experiments.
source_provenance.gap: Original hardware for delivering or amplifying stimuli was replaced.

trajectory_count.gap: No moving-source manipulation in discrimination control.

trajectory_path.gap: Control compares noise delivery modes and interval designs.

stimulus_duration.gap: Not established independently for the supplementary control.

gain_envelope.gap: Not established independently for the supplementary control.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Same vibrator type, new computer and peripheral hardware.
renderer_or_apparatus.gap: Actual levels need not correspond to Experiments 1–4.

condition_intermixing.value: 1-IFC and 2-IFC crossed with continuous and discrete noise for each task.

blocked_or_random_order.gap: Not established independently for the supplementary control.

iti_jitter_policy.gap: Not established independently for the supplementary control.

response_window.gap: Not established independently for the supplementary control.

task_sequence_rules.value: Detect or discriminate tactile intensities under 1- or 2-interval task instructions.

tactile_stimulus.value: Train to 90% detection threshold. 2-IFC discrimination uses one threshold stimulus and one at 1.5× threshold. A separate single-participant series varies intensity ratio 1.2–2.4.

soa_table.gap: No spatially varied audiotactile SOA schedule.

baseline_strategy.gap: Not established independently for the supplementary control.

catch_trial_type.gap: Not established independently for the supplementary control.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.gap: Total includes other detection and training sessions with unreported counts.

baseline_count.gap: Not established independently for the supplementary control.

catch_count.gap: Not established independently for the supplementary control.

block_count.source: Holmes et al., publisher/OSF Supplementary Materials, printed pp. 24–26, Supplementary Experiment 5 and Supplementary Fig. 4
block_count.gap: The supplement says participants performed each task once per interval count and noise mode. Training and repeat block counts are unreported. The separate 14-block follow-up has its own row.

total_trial_count.gap: Not established independently for the supplementary control.

implementation_gaps: Requires both one- and two-interval tactile response modes, matched continuous or discrete masking, separate calibrated thresholds and the original timing parameters.
The replacement signal generation and amplification change the physical command-to-vibration relation. Detection counts and exact response device are unavailable.
